summary: Instinct Bio Technical Company Holdings Inc. filed a Form 6-K on July 28, 2026, announcing an indicative term sheet for a proposed equity purchase facility to sell up to $150 million of common stock over three years, at VWAP minus a discount, with the company having discretion to draw. The facility provides flexible capital for regenerative medicine platform development, working capital, and acquisitions. No definitive terms, price per share, or premium were disclosed. The filing is a capital-raising arrangement, not a special situation. Watch for execution and dilution impact.
